evals.expected_output: Route test in routes.test.ts on real local D1 with Japanese title.
assertions: The test is added to worker/board/routes.test.ts using its existing getPlatformProxy / app.request harness (D1 not mocked)
The test title is in Japanese
The test asserts both the HTTP status and the rows remaining in the DB
The test checks that the new revision differs from the previous one
The test checks that another user's rows are not deleted
Ran the targeted test file and reports it passing
Did not modify production code
